nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design

nodes.label: Personal Groups
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Owner-owned personal recipient lists contain only accepted friends, with transactionally enforced plan limits and ownership/friendship checks. No shared admins, public identity, chat or independent history. Archive blocks new invites/members; later edits preserve prior invite snapshots and watch history.

nodes.label: Recent People
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Derived from authenticated shared sessions, one row per other user ordered by latest shared activity. Exclude self, accepted/pending/blocked/hidden people and dedupe against Friends. Use the same versioned account social snapshot, never another relationship type or cache.

nodes.label: Resume Progress
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Latest accepted checkpoint per user/provider/title/episode is monotonic by accepted observation time. Stale offline checkpoints may remain historical evidence but cannot regress resume progress.

nodes.label: Rollback
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Retain additive migrations and durable account/history/invite data, with old compatible read paths available during transition. No destructive backfill/table replacement. Notification permission rollout belongs to the complete notification slice.

nodes.label: Room Invites
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Atomic host/room validation, accepted-friend or owned-group resolution, invite/recipient snapshot creation and stable clientActionId dedupe. Maximum 100 recipients and 20 new actions per sender per minute. One semantic invite per room/recipient survives overlapping direct/group targeting, retry and decline; no duplicate notification. Acceptance retains normal capacity/admission checks; ROOM_FULL leaves pending intact.

nodes.label: Server Reconcile
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: One transactional RPC deduplicates authenticated user plus clientEventId, validates provider/URL and room proof, writes only that user, conditionally advances resume, and applies plan limits. Future timestamps over five minutes ahead clamp to serverTime. Expected per-event rejection cannot starve unrelated items; unexpected database failure rolls back and preserves retry intent.

nodes.label: Session Identity
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Solo random clientSessionId is reused for the same account/resource only within 30 minutes of local activity. Shared identity derives from roomId, roomGeneration, sourceGeneration and videoFingerprint; do not assume stable roomGeneration increments on reset. Shared metadata requires a room token bound to room and user.

nodes.label: Shared Contracts
nodes.community_name: Account Data Watch History Social Inbox Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: packages/protocol owns Zod runtime schemas and inferred types for checkpoints, libraries, sessions, social, groups, invites, inbox and mutations. Parse every response; a TypeScript cast is not validation. Shared builders/fixtures and serverTime/schemaVersion metadata keep web and Popup values consistent without requiring a global account revision.

nodes.label: Account History Generation Fencing
nodes.rationale: A server-owned history generation fences caches, outboxes, responses, and old writes so a full clear cannot be undone by delayed work.

nodes.label: Bounded-Shape Watch History Outbox
nodes.rationale: Each logical session and episode key retains only one pending terminal and one latest non-terminal event, bounding retry state by shape instead of invented age or count limits.

nodes.label: Cursor-Bounded Title Projection
nodes.rationale: The additive projection selects a title page before transporting progress and limits requester-owned session enrichment, eliminating account-wide aggregation and session fanout.

nodes.label: Durable History Deletion Fences
nodes.rationale: Episode and title fences reject queued pre-delete events and remain durable; full clear advances the account generation before old-generation fences can be removed.

nodes.label: Idempotency-First Conflict Ordering
nodes.rationale: Receipts are checked before mutation, while normalized observation time plus server order resolves new events without allowing retries or future-skewed clocks to poison canonical progress.

nodes.label: Local-First YouTube Preference
nodes.rationale: YouTube capture is off by default and a browser-local explicit choice becomes immediately authoritative, while account preference is only an asynchronous seed and mirror.

nodes.label: Logical Clean Pre-Release Cutover
nodes.rationale: Because the product is pre-release and existing history is test data, v1 writers and readers stop together while legacy storage remains inert for rollback instead of adding backfill, dual reads, or adapters.

nodes.label: Migration-First Production Deployment Ordering
nodes.rationale: Database and application workflows react independently, so the migration-only promotion must complete and be verified before the runtime promotion can safely consume the new RPC.

nodes.label: Quota-Aware Storage Recovery
nodes.rationale: Runtime Chrome byte accounting, immediate flush and coalescing, one retry, terminal preservation, and a visible storage-full state avoid silent data loss without adding unlimitedStorage.

nodes.label: Room Lifecycle Authority Gate
nodes.rationale: Self-contained attestations are authorized only when retained room and membership evidence, issuance bounds, claim matching, two-writer evidence, and shared-key risk all pass the threat-model gate.

nodes.label: Client plane: WXT extension and provider adapters
nodes.norm_label: client plane: wxt extension and provider adapters
nodes.rationale: The extension detects video identity, controls playback, and renders isolated player-attached UI. Users watch their own provider video; the extension does not host, proxy, record, or distribute source video.

nodes.label: Control plane: apps/web and Supabase
nodes.rationale: Durable users, profiles, subscriptions, rooms, memberships, and watch progress belong to the website and Supabase.

nodes.label: Live plane: apps/api, Durable Objects, and WebSockets
nodes.norm_label: live plane: apps/api, durable objects, and websockets
nodes.rationale: A room maps to a Durable Object owning playback, presence, reactions, chat, and P2P signaling. Fast live state should not become per-second Postgres writes.

nodes.label: pg_net Transport Boundary

Accepted mitigation is fixed owned URL, drain-only credential, 40-second timeout and exact HTTP 200 plus small {ok:true} acknowledgement. SQL cron success is not HTTP drain success or user receipt; lost transient work leaves the durable outbox intact.
